About iAgency

Where strategy meets impact

Founded by Ian Zaragoza and Aldeza Dela Torre, iAgencyPH was built with a singular belief — that marketing done right changes everything. We craft tailored solutions that don't just reach audiences, but move them.

With a team of skilled professionals and one of the Philippines' largest active influencer networks, we bring brands to life across every channel that matters.
